Title: Document 6
Content: Source: author unknown, song composed and sung primarily by the lower ranks in the British army.
:ibox:(Sung to the tune of “Onward Christian Soldiers”)
Forward Joe Soap's army, marching without fear,
With our old commander, safely in the rear.
He boasts and skites [brags] from morn till night,
But the men who really did the job are dead and in their grave.
